releaseNotes:
- Applies the Agent's current available-model policy to new and existing conversations at each new turn; preserves admitted Runs, approvals, questions and historical execution settings
- Refreshes stale model choices after admission rejection, preserves the message draft and requires an explicit available model instead of silently changing the selection
- Uses the selected model for native model-switch compaction and abandoned-continuation cleanup without granting a removed model access to new work
- Generates SDK and web conversation titles with the model selected by the admitted first turn, using declared low or disabled reasoning capabilities without changing the business Run's settings
- Gives title requests a 2048-token allowance and one bounded 4096-token recovery for exhausted output with no visible title; respects each model's configured output limit
- Allows a failed title job to recover on a later admitted user turn, preserves durable attempt limits across refresh and restart, and settles interrupted background jobs without repeating model requests
- Keeps private reasoning and upstream error bodies out of title previews and durable title failure messages
- Reuses Runtime `1.0.0` and existing sandbox templates; preserves configuration, conversations, workspace files, attachments and Skills
